title: Saltglass Cavern: The Navigator's Resonance Tablet
premise: In a crystalline underworld cut by migratory subterranean rivers, the navigator must synchronize the return route to the signal using a star-and-current sextant.
ending: Recover the Resonance Tablet and return with the verified return bearing; Cavern Chorus can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive shard bloom while evading the mineral sentinel without sacrificing the verified return bearing.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Cavern Chorus to witness the star-and-current sextant.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to accept an unverified coordinate
